desc: Ideation and reduction to stable intervals with prefix sums and transformed boundary conditions.
Implement prefix sums P, transformed array C, sentinel handling, and R_i computation by binary search on P.
Implement iterative segment tree over C supporting leftmost/rightmost index with value >= threshold.
Implement serviceR computation, DSU descending assignment, and answer queries (initial version).
Fix off-by-one in serviceR computation (`p = find_last(R, th)` instead of `p - 1`) and verify sample 2 K=7.
Re-test samples and edge cases (N=2, all equal, strictly increasing/decreasing, sentinel-only intervals).
